hypothesis: Trailing 1-5 day residual returns (vs market + sector factors estimated on trailing data only) negatively predict next 1-5 day residual returns in liquid US large/mid caps, for moves not accompanied by material company news
signal_definition: z = -(sum of residual returns over last k_s days) / rolling residual vol; residual from rolling 120-day OLS on SPY + sector ETF (PCA-3 as second implementation); decision time 15:40 ET using 5-min bars through 15:40 plus daily data through t-1
universe: point-in-time S&P 500 members passing t-1 liquidity filter, no-news subsample
features: residual return, residual vol, abnormal turnover, news flags
model: Fama-MacBeth cross-sectional regression with Newey-West; decile long-short portfolio
parameters: k_s in {1,3,5}; OLS window 120; z-score window 60
expected_result: negative FM slope with |t|>=2; decile long-short gross return > 0
falsification_condition: FM slope not significantly negative (NW t < 2) OR decile long-short gross return <= 0 on the no-news subsample

hypothesis: Reversal is concentrated in low-abnormal-turnover movers; high-abnormal-turnover movers show continuation (Medhat & Schmeling 2022)
signal_definition: interaction of residual-return z-score with abnormal turnover tercile (turnover_t / trailing 60-day mean)
model: FM regression with interaction term; double sort
expected_result: negative coefficient in low-turnover tercile; non-negative/positive in high-turnover tercile

hypothesis: Expected reversal return rises with lagged market volatility (Nagel 2012)
signal_definition: strategy return regressed on lagged VIX (or realized SPY vol) terciles
expected_result: positive slope; highest tercile earns most

hypothesis: Residual (factor-cleaned) reversal beats raw reversal risk-adjusted (Blitz et al. 2013; Da et al. 2014)
signal_definition: raw k-day return z-score vs residual k-day return z-score
model: decile portfolios; Sharpe comparison with bootstrap CI

hypothesis: Net-of-cost profitability survives in the most liquid tercile with turnover-aware construction (De Groot et al. 2012)
signal_definition: frozen DEV-selected construction applied to VAL
universe: most liquid tercile of PIT universe
falsification_condition: net Sharpe <= 0 under base costs on untouched VAL

hypothesis: Decay curve implies optimal holding <= 5 days; gross alpha per unit turnover falls monotonically beyond
signal_definition: IC and long-short return by forward horizon 1..20 days
expected_result: peak alpha per turnover at k <= 5

hypothesis: Residual reversal is materially stronger for no-news moves than for moves accompanied by material company news (8-K and/or article flag known by the decision time)
signal_definition: news flag = 8-K accepted since previous decision time OR FMP article/keyword hit before decision time; interaction with reversal signal
universe: as H1 (full universe, split by news flag)
features: news flags (Tier 1 8-K items; Tier 2 article counts 2012+)
model: FM regression with news interaction; filter ablation ladder

hypothesis: Residual moves accompanied by material news show post-news drift (continuation) over 1-10 days (Chan 2003; Tetlock 2011)
signal_definition: news-mover subsample; forward residual return by horizon
falsification_condition: no significant positive drift on DEV

hypothesis: FALLBACK FAMILY (only if H1 is falsified): sector/industry-ETF residual returns vs SPY mean-revert at 1-5 days
signal_definition: ETF residual return z-score vs SPY
universe: liquid US sector/industry ETFs fixed by inception date and t-1 liquidity before download
model: pooled panel regression with Driscoll-Kraay SEs; top-3/bottom-3 rank long-short
